# Ally Bohanan Real Estate

> Ally Bohanan Real Estate is a Belmont, NC real estate team led by broker Ally Bohanan (NC license #315170, SC license #114167), brokered by Northstar Real Estate, LLC. It helps people buy, sell and build homes in Gaston County, NC, York County, SC and the greater Charlotte area, with custom homes through Bohanan Construction.

Facts on this site come from Ally’s own listings and sales record, official town, county and venue sources (linked on each page), and her first-hand local knowledge. Pages show an "Updated" date; prices, hours and events change, so confirm with the linked source.

## Key facts

- Business: Ally Bohanan Real Estate (residential real estate: buying, selling, luxury homes, land and custom building)

- [Living in Dallas, NC: Courthouse Square Guide](https://allybohananrealestate.com/dallas/): Dallas, NC, Gaston County’s original county seat: the historic courthouse square, the Gaston County Museum of Art & History and Gaston College.
- [Living in Lowell, NC: River & Trail Guide](https://allybohananrealestate.com/lowell/): Lowell, NC on the South Fork River: Woodlawn Mill, McCord Family Park, Spencer Mountain and the trails at George Poston Park.
- [Living in McAdenville, NC: Christmas Town USA Guide](https://allybohananrealestate.com/mc-adenville/): McAdenville, NC, Christmas Town USA: about 650 residents, Legacy Park, the McAdenville Greenway and the December lights.
- [Living on Lake Wylie: Lake & Community Guide](https://allybohananrealestate.com/lake-wylie/): Lake Wylie explained: the 13,443-acre lake on the NC/SC line, the York County, SC community, public access and what to ask before buying on the water.
- [Living in Clover, SC: Downtown & Land Guide](https://allybohananrealestate.com/clover/): Clover, SC in York County: Scots-Irish heritage, the Feis Chlobhair festival, Gallery 120 in the Larne Building and what to know about buying land to build.
- [Living in Fort Mill, SC: Main Street & Greenway Guide](https://allybohananrealestate.com/fort-mill/): Fort Mill, SC from a local Realtor: Main Street, the Fort Mill History Museum, Anne Springs Close Greenway, Baxter Village, Kingsley and Walter Y. Elisha Park.
- [Living in York, SC: Historic Downtown & Countryside](https://allybohananrealestate.com/york/): York, SC, the White Rose City: nearly 200 historically registered sites, Congress Street shops, Historic Brattonsville and the orchards around town.
- [Living in Rock Hill, SC: Old Town & River Guide](https://allybohananrealestate.com/rock-hill/): Rock Hill, SC: Old Town, the Mural Mile, Glencairn Garden, Fountain Park, Catawba Bend Preserve and the Rock Hill Sports & Event Center.
